subject: Copywriting
title: The Propaganda Techniques Checklist
description: Learn The Propaganda Techniques Checklist in one minute.

hook.text: In 1938, the Institute for Propaganda Analysis published 7 common techniques.

buildup.text: The seven: Name Calling, Glittering Generalities, Transfer, Testimonial, Plain Folks, Card Stacking, and Bandwagon.

discovery.text: 'Plain Folks' shows a billionaire eating at a diner. 'Transfer' wraps a product in a flag.

twist.text: Modern propaganda blends multiple techniques in a single message.

climax.text: The checklist turns invisible manipulation visible. Once you see the technique, the spell weakens.

punchline.text: Seven techniques from 1938. They still decode almost all propaganda.

quiz.question: How many techniques did the 1938 Institute for Propaganda Analysis identify?
